chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Only Ali will pay back [my debts] for me, and only Ali will fulfill my promises.'
ai.seo_question: Who is designated by the Prophet to fulfill his debts and promises?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores Ali ibn Abi Talib’s unique authority as the Prophet’s sole executor, emphasizing his role in settling both material debts and spiritual trusts. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted as a precursor to his designation (Nass) as the successor, highlighting his reliability in conveying the Prophet’s message and managing the community’s affairs after his departure.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-243 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
the Prophet (S) said, “Only Ali (a.s.) will pay back my debts and only Ali will fulfill my promises.”
